item.title: Alibaba Cloud's CUBE 5.0 Cuts AI Data-Center Build Time to 100 Days — and Ulanqab Is the New Chinese AIDC Hub
item.description: Alibaba Cloud's CUBE 5.0 modular design compresses AI data-center delivery to 100 days and cuts unit cost by 10 percent. The Ulanqab deployment is the canonical example, with the city now running 17.2 million P of compute and hosting 90 percent intelligent computing share.

item.title: China's AR Optical Waveguide Industry Enters Its Mass-Production Year — Greatar-Tech and PVG AR Lead the New Tech Routes
item.description: Several Chinese AR optical waveguide makers are crossing the million-unit capacity threshold in 2026, with Greatar-Tech at one million SRG units and Nika Optical opening an automated VHG line. The PVG AR line from Parallel Vision is the smallest in volume but the most differentiated in tech.

item.title: Tencent's SkillHub Crosses 100,000 Skills and Ten Million Monthly Downloads — and a TRACE Evaluation Layer Is Why Maybe Twenty Percent Still Matter
item.description: SkillHub, the OpenClaw-aligned AI skill community hosted by Tencent Lighthouse Cloud, now lists more than 100,000 AI skills and over 10 million monthly downloads. The TRACE evaluation framework is how the platform surfaces the 20 percent of skills that actually work.

item.title: Alibaba Launches CosyVoice Studio, Its First Full-Stack Voice AI Platform, and Bets Speech Is the Next Productivity Entry Point
item.description: CosyVoice Studio bundles Alibaba's Qwen-Audio speech family, including the Artificial Analysis top-ranked Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime, into one platform with three product modules. Alibaba is positioning speech as the next agent entry point, alongside text and vision.

item.title: Zhang Yiming Returns to ByteDance Headquarters and Tells the Seed Team to Stop Distilling
item.description: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming quietly returned to the Seed AI research team two weeks ago and laid down a no-distillation mandate. The mid-year All-Hands followed with a major B-side structure change that puts Doubao, Feishu and Volcano Engine under one product roof.
